regions.label: CAISO – system-wide
regions.default_date_reason: Weekday with the highest CAISO curtailment in Mar–May 2026 (98.5 GWh; #2 overall after Sun 2026-05-17).
notes: System-wide CAISO balancing area. PG&E-only net load is not available: GridStatus publishes PG&E-TAC load but solar, wind and curtailment only system-wide.

regions.label: ERCOT
regions.default_date_reason: Weekday with the deepest midday net-load dip in Mar–May 2026 (min = 19.8% of evening peak).
regions.lmp_label: Day-ahead settlement point price, Hub Average
notes: ERCOT does not publish renewable curtailment in GridStatus; conservative layer shown as not reported.

regions.label: PJM
regions.default_date_reason: Weekday with the deepest midday net-load dip in Mar–May 2026 (min = 63.7% of evening peak — a shallow dip).
notes: Fuel mix excludes behind-the-meter solar (already netted out of metered load).

regions.label: MISO
regions.default_date_reason: Weekday with the deepest midday net-load dip in Mar–May 2026, excl. Memorial Day (min = 60.2% of evening peak — shallow).

regions.label: SPP
regions.default_date_reason: Weekday with the highest SPP VER curtailment in Mar–May 2026 (204 GWh, mostly wind).
notes: Curtailment = SPP VER curtailments (redispatch + manual + curtailed-for-energy, wind + solar), East + West.

regions.label: NYISO
regions.default_date_reason: Weekday with the deepest midday net-load dip in Mar–May 2026 (min = 65.9% of evening peak — shallow).
notes: NYISO fuel mix has no separate grid-scale solar column (it's inside 'other renewables'); net load here = load − wind only. Behind-the-meter solar is already netted out of load.

regions.label: ISO-NE
regions.default_date_reason: Weekday with the deepest midday net-load dip in Mar–May 2026 (min = 40.0% of evening peak).
notes: Fuel-mix solar is grid-connected only; most New England solar is behind the meter.
